summary: Use runtime semantics for a Map constructed from an arbitrary iterable because iterator hooks, entry property access, adder lookup, and IteratorClose are observable.

target.notes: Runtime must perform Get(set), GetIterator, per-entry object validation, Get(entry,'0'/'1'), Call(adder), and IteratorClose on abrupt completion.

semantics.entry_requirement: each yielded item must be Object

caveats: Custom Symbol.iterator, getters on pair indices, overridden Map.prototype.set, and thrown JS values prevent a simple foreach lowering.

tests.name: primitive entry throws and closes iterator
tests.input: let closed=false; const it={ [Symbol.iterator](){return {next(){return {value:1,done:false}},return(){closed=true;return {done:true}}}}}; try{new Map(it)}catch(e){} console.log(closed);
